title: Hardware Armor & Tools
description: This mod adds new armor, tools, and weapons made from hardware, such as a RAM knife. It also adds new blocks needed to craft this hardware.
body:
This mod adds new armor, tools, and weapons made from hardware, such as a RAM knife. It also adds new blocks needed to craft this hardware.
- Farm raw materials like quartz sand to manufacture memory chips or other hardware.
- Craft weapons, tools, and armor from PC parts.

_The features mentioned here, such as weapons and armor, are still under development and will only be added in future updates. For now, the resources needed to manufacture these parts are being developed first._
